### FilterBuilder
A visual query builder for creating conditional filters with nested AND/OR logical clause groups, query preset persistence, and formatted SQL, MongoDB, & GraphQL export utilities.

**Import Path**:
```typescript
import { FilterBuilder } from "@/components/ui/filterBuilder/filterBuilder";
```

#### Default
A single-rule filter builder with field, operator, and value selectors.

```tsx
const [filter, setFilter] = React.useState<FilterGroup>({
  conjunction: "AND",
  rules: [{ field: "name", operator: "contains", value: "" }],
});

<FilterBuilder fields={defaultFields} value={filter} onChange={setFilter} />
```

#### Multiple Rules
Filter builder with multiple conditions and a toggleable AND/OR conjunction.

```tsx
const [filter, setFilter] = React.useState<FilterGroup>({
  conjunction: "AND",
  rules: [
    { field: "name", operator: "contains", value: "John" },
    { field: "age", operator: "greater_than", value: 18 },
    { field: "role", operator: "equals", value: "admin" },
  ],
});

<FilterBuilder fields={fields} value={filter} onChange={setFilter} />
```

#### Nested Sub-clauses, Preset Storage & Query Exporter
Build nested logical condition groups (AND/OR sub-clauses), save query presets to localStorage, and export formatted SQL, MongoDB, or GraphQL query clauses.

```tsx
<FilterBuilder
  fields={defaultFields}
  value={filter}
  onChange={setFilter}
  storageKey="user_reports"
  enableExport
/>
```

#### Props — FilterBuilder
Supported properties for the FilterBuilder component.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| storageKey | string | — | LocalStorage key for persisting user saved query presets. |
| enableExport | boolean | true | Enables SQL / MongoDB / GraphQL formatted query exporter modal. |
| fields | FilterField[] | — | Available fields for filter rules. |
| value | FilterGroup | — | Current filter state with nested conjunctions and rules. |
